title: August Windows app update requires a second handoff to replace its Python runtime
errors: ^E2E ASSERTION FAILED: app driven via captured hermes desktop spec; update completed$
signatures: gateway auto-restart failed: cannot import name 'base_url_origin' from 'utils'
SQLite runtime repair deferred: the updater itself runs from the live venv it must replace
SQLite 3\.45\.1 still has the WAL-reset corruption bug
explanation: The released PowerShell handoff keeps running its loaded script after the checkout changes and retries from the venv it must replace. This leg preserves that failed attempt, invokes the newly installed handoff separately, and requires a safe SQLite runtime, successful completion receipt, target checkout and usable desktop. It is a recovered historical failure, not a successful first app update; failed recovery keeps the job red.

title: August CLI update needs a fresh process after the checkout changes
signatures: gateway auto-restart failed: cannot import name 'base_url_origin' from 'utils'
explanation: The released CLI keeps its old utils module in memory after pulling the new checkout. The first attempt failed; this leg separately retries from a fresh process and requires the full post-update checks to pass. A failed recovery still fails the job.

title: Released Windows updater locks its own console launcher
signatures: failed to remove file[^\r\n]*Scripts[/\\]hermes\.exe[^\r\n]*Access is denied\. \(os error 5\)
explanation: The March/April Windows updater is already running from hermes.exe when uv tries to replace it. Windows refuses the locked launcher. The update target cannot change that loaded code; re-running the installer is a separate recovery route.

title: July script installs offer a manual update instead of an app hand-off
errors: ^E2E ASSERTION FAILED: app driven via captured hermes desktop spec; update completed$
^E2E ASSERTION FAILED: GUI driver clicked Update now and the app quit for hand-off$
signatures: \[updates\] no staged updater; surfacing manual `hermes update` for CLI install at
explanation: The July Windows app has no staged updater after a script install. Its Update button explicitly returns manual: hermes update without starting a hand-off. Desktop-installer installs are not covered by this exception.
